name: room
text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text:
Run PR-Agent in parallel mode on *all PRs* but *flag* new contributors’ feedback to maintain quality while catching issues early.

Trade-off: This adds slight overhead for reviewers but prevents silent failures from new contributors.

name: Gauge
text: PR-Agent in parallel mode trains reviewers to ignore *all* automated feedback—it’s not just slower false-positive detection, it’s eroding human judgment. Better alternative: run PR-Agent in *sequential* mode for new contributors only, then escalate only if the human reviewer flags an issue. Settle this by measuring reviewer response time and false-positive acceptance rates before and after the change.
